description: Why the trader LIKED a name for a day trade and passed on it anyway. Starting vocabulary agreed with the trader 2026-08-31: 'many times I really like this stock for a daytrade but it has this ONE issue' - so these are single blocking objections against a name the trader wanted, not a rejection of the chart (that is veto_reasons, a separate family with its own version series). Multiple reasons may be ticked for one pass. Codes are permanent identifiers: a code is never renamed or reused for a different meaning, because rows already written carry it. A later vocabulary adds pass_reasons_v2.json alongside this file and leaves v1 readable for the rows stamped with it. Labels are the trader's own words, unedited.

reasons.label: Poor market conditions
reasons.hint: The tape or the index was wrong for it, whatever this name was doing.

reasons.label: Low rvol
reasons.hint: Relative volume too thin to trust the move or to get out of it.

reasons.label: LRSI/SMI incongruency
reasons.hint: The oscillators disagreed with the price move or with each other.

reasons.label: Incoming Horizontal
reasons.hint: A horizontal level sits close enough ahead to cap or catch the trade.

reasons.label: Other incoming S/R
reasons.hint: Some other support or resistance arrives in the path: a line, a moving average, a band.
